summary: Teresa Proaño co-wrote a Daly City Council ceasefire resolution with Vice Mayor Daus-Magbual in June 2024, calling for a bilateral ceasefire, hostage release, and condemning killings in Gaza. The Mercury News confirmed the council passed the resolution on June 4, 2024, making Daly City the latest Peninsula city to adopt one. Her campaign platform addresses local public safety, small-business permitting, and housing.
